interventions.description: Apply murals or artistic treatments to the blank concrete wall to improve the aesthetic quality and reduce the 'hostile' feel of the infrastructure.

interventions.title: Vertical Delineation
interventions.description: If traffic speeds are high, consider adding bollards or a more substantial physical barrier at the curb line to protect pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a raised pedestrian refuge island in the center painted buffer area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Physical Separation
interventions.description: Install a physical barrier, such as a railing or bollards, to protect pedestrians from the adjacent travel lane.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed reduction measures or signage to slow vehicles as they approach and pass through the narrow underpass.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked concrete to provide a smooth and accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or bollards between the sidewalk and the road to increase safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add dedicated lighting under the bridge structure to improve visibility and security for pedestrians in the underpass.

interventions.title: Bollards or Enhanced Planters
interventions.description: Installing bollards or more substantial, continuous planters along the curb would provide a physical barrier against vehicle incursions.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with signage to provide a designated and safer path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Enhance the existing buffer with more consistent greenery to narrow the driver's field of vision and slow traffic.
